source.text:
Special Ammo Sword
Drops with a random Sword Frame and Exotic Intrinsic. Impact Stat has no effect on perk damage. Frame exclusively determines Heavy Attack.
Breaker Type is determined by Exotic Trait.

Kills grant an additional 2.5% Light Transcendent Energy and 2.5% Dark Transcendent Energy.

While Transcendent:
35% [20%] increased damage and +50 Charge Rate. Does not include +5% from Transcendence.
Exotic Intrinsic Effects (Wolfpack, Perfect Fifth, Arc Conductor, Unplanned Reprieve, etc) are instead granted 20% increased damage.
Dealing any Sword Damage triggers the increased Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed.
Extends Transcendent duration by an additional ?% kill.

↑Transcendent Steel:
+3 [+1] Ammo upon scoring a Prismatic Grenade Hit. 
Only triggers on certain hits, averaging 3 to 4 procs per Prismatic Grenade thrown.
